elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: Section (c) applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Licensor must provide transition assistance to Licensee.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(i) requires Licensor, at Licensee’s request, to “provide reasonable transition assistance.” The request condition is controlled by Licensee and is consistent with making assistance available when needed.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(i) expressly provides assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Licensor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(i) expressly states “at Licensor’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Licensor must return all Licensee Data to Licensee.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(ii) requires Licensor to “return to Licensee all Licensee Data” and defines the covered data.

elements.element: Licensee Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(ii) requires return “within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Licensee Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(ii) requires a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the standard machine-readable format requirement.

elements.element: Licensor must delete all Licensee Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(iii) requires Licensor to “thereafter delete all Licensee Data from its systems.”

elements.element: Licensor must certify deletion of the Licensee Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(iii) requires Licensor to “certify such deletion in writing to Licensee.”

elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the agreement.
elements.evidence: Section (c) applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Licensor must provide transition assistance to Licensee.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(i) requires Licensor, at Licensee’s request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The stated period of up to six months exceeds the fallback 90-day assistance period.

elements.element: Licensor must export Licensee Data to Licensee.
elements.evidence: The obligation to return all Licensee Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format constitutes a data export.

elements.element: The Licensee Data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(ii) requires return within thirty days of expiry or termination.

result.reason: The added operative subsection fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It covers both expiry and termination, six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of all defined Licensee Data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, subsequent deletion, and written certification. The amendment is confined to reciprocal exit obligations and does not disturb the original return-of-property provisions. Drafting quality is low solely due to a 'commonly used machine-readable' standard deviating from the desired 'standard machine-readable' formulation.
